# America's ToothFairy

> America's ToothFairy is a nonprofit organization dedicated to increasing dental care access and oral health education for underserved children across the United States.

Founded by Dr. Cherilyn Sheets, America's ToothFairy operates multiple programs including the Dental Resource Program, Smile Drive, Smile Guardian Program, and HERO Program to serve low-income communities. The organization partners with dental suppliers, health centers, and volunteers to provide preventive dentistry education, resource kits, and toothbrush donations to at-risk children.

- [America's ToothFairy](https://www.americastoothfairy.org): Homepage introducing America's ToothFairy nonprofit mission to increase dental care access for underserved children.
- [About Us](https://www.americastoothfairy.org/about-us): Organization history, mission, vision, and board members including founder Dr. Cherilyn Sheets.
- [20 Years of Saving Smiles](https://www.americastoothfairy.org/stories/20-years-of-saving-smiles): Founder story celebrating 20-year anniversary of Dr. Cherilyn Sheets' America's ToothFairy mission.

## Programs & Initiatives

- [Programs & Resources](https://www.americastoothfairy.org/programs): Overview of America's ToothFairy's main programs including Dental Resource Program and In the Gap Program.
- [Dental Resource Program](https://www.americastoothfairy.org/stories/17-500-kids-start-the-year-smiling): Impact story about Dental Resource Program supporting E.A. Hawse Health Center in Baker, West Virginia.
- [Smile Guardian Program](https://www.americastoothfairy.org/programs/smile-guardian-program): Details on Smile Guardian Program offering resource kits for oral health education in at-risk communities.
- [Smile Drive](https://www.americastoothfairy.org/programs/smile-drive): Smile Drive Program providing toothbrush donations and volunteer opportunities for low-income families.
